title: EnchCoalTracker
description: A Hypixel Skyblock mod used for tracking coins/h when coal mining.
body:
# EnchCoalTracker
Coal mining tracker for Hypixel Skyblock

Commands: 
/ect reset: Resets the tracker back to 0

/ect pos (x) (y): Change the position of the hud on your screen

/ect api key (key) Used for putting your Hypixel API key for accurate tracking

/ect color (hex code): Change the color of the hud. Example: /ect color 0000FF (blue)

/ect toggle: Toggle the mod on/off

/ect api interval (seconds): Set the rate of how fast you want the mod to update

(Keep in mind that the Hypixel API is usually slower than what you set it to. If you set it to 1 second, the mod will overuse the API key and cause issues. So I suggest staying above 2 seconds.)
